prespecification_scope: Frozen at the recorded UTC after the user clarification and before Circle fine-grid outcomes were known, as directed by root. Prior Square and Circle medium results were already available; this is not blind whole-study preregistration.
user_constraint_change_rationale: Explicit user constraint change: compare Square and Circle at nearest hub spacing 8 cm; Circle may grow as large as needed. Equal projected box is no longer the primary layout constraint. This scope change is user-driven, not selected by outcomes.

source_master_row.distance_parameter_definition: Legacy square half-side d; nearest original-to-added spacing d for eight rotors, nearest hub spacing 2d for four.
source_master_row.initialization_controller_state_policy: Only U and p are mapped. The unchanged actuator source reinitializes its static relaxed thrust to the target inferred from mapped velocity at the first nonzero-time update; controller history is not transferred. This is a mapped/reinitialized run, not a continuation of complete source state.
source_master_row.projected_geometry_normal_policy: Accepted unit-normal tolerance checked, then normalized for projected ellipse metrics.
source_master_row.optimization_control_reason: Inside 0–10 cm search range; nominal ranking also requires role, source, power, geometry and initialization qualification.
source_master_row.projected_convex_hull_area_definition: Convex hull of the union of horizontally projected swept disks; not union area; excludes actuator thickness.
